hosts-delete-body: This removes "{name}" and its {count} download links.
hosts-intro: Owned games are files on a host. Paste an Internet Archive item link and index it: the system is detected from the item, and zip, 7z, chd or plain ROM files are matched to the catalog by title. A MiNERVA Archive folder is indexed from its torrent, and its files are fetched through the debrid account in DEBRID_API_KEY. For any other server, add links from a game's page.
hosts-none: No hosts yet. Add an Internet Archive item or a file server.
